description: Satu Peta (One Map) Indonesia is a geoportal run by Coordinating Ministry for Economic Affairs and Geospatial Information Agency, Indonesia. The portal gives a single access point to the thematic geospatial layers of Indonesian ministries under the One Map Policy, including infrastructure, spatial-plan, land-use and hazard themes. Coverage: Indonesia. It is reached online through the home page and its search, download or service pages, in forms such as wms, shp; access is free of charge and open to view; downloads may need a free account. The licence is: terms set by the site, not read in this search. Caveats: the home page was opened on 2026-09-30 and only its title ("Test") was read, so the holdings, the current terms and the availability of downloads were not browsed, and this description rests on the agency's publicly documented role and may lag the site. The page title read on 2026-09-30 was only "Test", so the service may still be in preparation. It can support infrastructure planning and hazard exposure studies of Indonesia.
